name: Clipboard History V
description:
Clipboard history in a popup, in the style of the Win+V panel.

This extension reads the clipboard to keep a list of the last 25 text and image items you copied. Nothing is ever sent anywhere.

- Set a keyboard shortcut in the preferences first (none is set by default), for example Super+V
- The popup opens next to the text cursor; click an item or press Enter to paste it
- Hold the shortcut's modifier and tap the key again to move down the list; release the modifier to paste
- Pin items to keep them at the top and after a restart
- Unpinned items are kept only in memory and are cleared when you log out
- Items marked secret by password managers are never saved
